evidence_required: FT-006-AC-004 / REQ-010 / REQ-012 / REQ-015 RED: an attendance correction or charge cancellation produces nondeterministic financial state, misses audit, or partially mutates; GREEN: Financial Ledger deterministically replays the financial consequence from the historical sequence with author/time/change audit and atomic failure; artifact: .tasks/TASK-044-T3-FT-006-W22/ and .protocols/TASK-044-T3-FT-006-W22/.
purpose: Own only the Financial Ledger consequence of attendance correction and charge replay.
success_outcome: After Learning Progress authorizes an attendance transition, Financial Ledger deterministically creates/recalculates the charge, allocations, and balance with an audit record or leaves financial state unchanged on failure.
anti_goals: Do not write or own attendance state.
Do not let Learning Progress insert or edit charge, allocation, balance, or audit rows directly.
constraints: Learning Progress owns attendance and calls the named reconciliation command.
Financial Ledger owns charge, allocation, balance, and audit writes.
invariants: Absent creates no charge; absent-to-present uses the historical price.
A failed reconciliation leaves all financial state unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-006-AC-004: prove individual and group correction/replay, historical pricing, deterministic allocation/balance, audit author/time/change, rollback, and unrelated-student isolation.
Ownership: source/runtime proof confirms attendance remains in Learning Progress and no consumer writes financial tables.

stop_conditions: Stop if the reconciliation requires moving attendance ownership or changing the accepted cross-boundary transaction contract.
